# Install VexelRay preflight

Snapshot builds of every VexelRay application, built together from the same sources, to try before they are released. The install command for the releases is in the README one folder up.

## Windows

Open **PowerShell** (a normal window - administrator rights are not needed) and run:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/preflight/install.ps1 | iex
```

A window opens where you choose which of the applications below to install, and whether they get
shortcuts, PATH entries and file types; it then shows each one's progress. That installs them for your
user only. Each one is a separate install with its own
folder, its own entry in **Settings > Apps**, and its own updater and uninstaller, so you can remove one
and keep the others. Running the same line again installs these versions again, so a rebuilt snapshot replaces the one installed.

| Application | What it is | Id | Version | Installed to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Vexplore](https://sibarum.github.io/vexelray-framework/apps/vexplore.html) | A file explorer that suggests instead of asking. | `vexplore` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Vexplore` |
| [Vex](https://sibarum.github.io/vexelray-framework/apps/text-editor.html) | A tabbed text editor with a file navigator, on the VexelRay stack. | `text-editor` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Vex` |
| [Pix](https://sibarum.github.io/vexelray-framework/apps/pix.html) | An image viewer: one picture, as large as the window allows, and the rest of its folder a key press away. | `pix` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Pix` |
| [MainFrame](https://sibarum.github.io/vexelray-framework/apps/mainframe.html) | A terminal window that wraps the native Windows shell over ConPTY, built on the VexelRay stack. | `mainframe` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\MainFrame` |
| [Calculator](https://sibarum.github.io/vexelray-framework/apps/calculator.html) | A small calculator window onto cott-engine. | `calculator` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Calculator` |
| [Fluid Sim](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-sim-fluid) | Fluid simulation experiments on the VexelRay stack: dam breaks, mixing, heat and a 3D dam break, live on the GPU. | `fluid-sim` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Fluid Sim` |
| [Rigid Sim](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-sim-rigid) | Rigid-body simulation experiments on the VexelRay stack: spheres that collide, bounce, spin and roll, live on the GPU. | `rigid-sim` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Rigid Sim` |
| [Maistro](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-maistro) | A desktop client for Claude Code, on the VexelRay stack: the conversation beside a mind map its replies grow. Needs the Claude Code CLI, logged in. | `maistro` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Maistro` |
| [VexelRay Inspector](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-inspector) | DevTools for VexelRay applications, drawn as clockwork: attach to a running app and watch its frame loop beat, park and stall. | `inspector` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\VexelRay Inspector` |

Each application is installed by its own installer, the same one its own install command runs. This
script downloads that installer, checks it against the SHA-256 in the application's published manifest,
and runs it. The installer then checks every file it downloads in the same way. An application that has
not been published yet is skipped and reported.

### Only some of them

Untick the others in the window. Without the window (see below), set `INSTALL_ONLY` in the same PowerShell
window *before* the install command; with it, `INSTALL_ONLY` says which boxes start ticked:

```powershell
$env:INSTALL_ONLY = 'vexplore,text-editor'
```

### Everything, without being asked

Run the script as a script block, which takes arguments, as `irm | iex` cannot:

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/preflight/install.ps1))) --install-everything --do-not-prompt-me
```

`--install-everything` installs every application, the optional ones too (`$env:INSTALL_EVERYTHING = '1'`
does the same), and `--do-not-prompt-me` opens no window and asks nothing (as `$env:INSTALL_QUIET = '1'`).
Either one works alone.

### Options

These are passed on to every application's installer:

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `$env:INSTALL_NO_SHORTCUTS = '1'` | skip the desktop / Start menu shortcuts |
| `$env:INSTALL_NO_PATH = '1'` | do not add anything to your user PATH |
| `$env:INSTALL_NO_ASSOCIATIONS = '1'` | do not register any application to open file types |
| `$env:INSTALL_FORCE = '1'` | reinstall even where the latest version is already installed |
| `$env:INSTALL_SKIP_CHECKS = '1'` | install even where this computer does not meet an application's system requirements |
| `$env:INSTALL_QUIET = '1'` | no window: ask nothing and report in this PowerShell window only |

With the window, the first three set how its boxes start.

A particular version or folder applies to one application, so this script ignores `INSTALL_VERSION` and
`INSTALL_DIR`. To use them, run that application's own installer.

### Update

Run the install command again, or update one application from its folder:

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Vexplore\update.cmd"
```

### Uninstall

Use **Settings > Apps**, where each application has its own entry, or run the uninstaller in any of their
folders:

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Vexplore\uninstall.cmd" -Id vexplore
```

`-List` shows every install it knows about. Each application's install record is in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\vexelray-installer\installs`,
which is also how the applications find and start each other.

### Is it safe to run a script from the internet?

Read it first - it is one file: [`install.ps1`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/preflight/install.ps1). It runs only installers whose SHA-256
matches their application's manifest, and those installers accept a download only when its SHA-256
matches too.

## Linux

Open a terminal and run (no `sudo`: everything is installed for your user only):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/preflight/install.sh | sh
```

That installs each of the applications below as an install of its own, with its own folder, updater and
uninstaller, so you can remove one and keep the others. Running the same line again installs these versions again, so a rebuilt snapshot replaces the one installed. Vexplore, Fluid Sim, Rigid Sim and Maistro have no Linux version yet, so they are left out.

| Application | What it is | Id | Version | Installed to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Vex](https://sibarum.github.io/vexelray-framework/apps/text-editor.html) | A tabbed text editor with a file navigator, on the VexelRay stack. | `text-editor` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `~/.local/opt/text-editor` |
| [Pix](https://sibarum.github.io/vexelray-framework/apps/pix.html) | An image viewer: one picture, as large as the window allows, and the rest of its folder a key press away. | `pix` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `~/.local/opt/pix` |
| [MainFrame](https://sibarum.github.io/vexelray-framework/apps/mainframe.html) | A terminal window that wraps the native Windows shell over ConPTY, built on the VexelRay stack. | `mainframe` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `~/.local/opt/mainframe` |
| [Calculator](https://sibarum.github.io/vexelray-framework/apps/calculator.html) | A small calculator window onto cott-engine. | `calculator` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `~/.local/opt/calculator` |
| [VexelRay Inspector](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-inspector) | DevTools for VexelRay applications, drawn as clockwork: attach to a running app and watch its frame loop beat, park and stall. | `inspector` | `0.1.2-SNAPSHOT` | `~/.local/opt/inspector` |

Each application is installed by its own installer, the same one its own install command runs. This
script downloads that installer, checks it against the SHA-256 in the application's published manifest,
and runs it. The installer then checks every file it downloads in the same way. An application that has
not been published yet is skipped and reported.

### Only some of them, or everything

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/preflight/install.sh | INSTALL_ONLY=text-editor,pix sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/preflight/install.sh | sh -s -- --install-everything
```

`--install-everything` (or `INSTALL_EVERYTHING=1`) installs the optional applications too.

### Options

These are passed on to every application's installer, set the same way as `INSTALL_ONLY`:

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `INSTALL_NO_SHORTCUTS=1` | no menu entries or desktop launchers |
| `INSTALL_NO_PATH=1` | link nothing into `~/.local/bin` |
| `INSTALL_NO_ASSOCIATIONS=1` | do not register any application to open file types |
| `INSTALL_FORCE=1` | reinstall even where the latest version is already installed |
| `INSTALL_SKIP_CHECKS=1` | install even where this computer does not meet an application's system requirements |

A particular version or folder applies to one application, so this script ignores `INSTALL_VERSION` and
`INSTALL_DIR`. To use them, run that application's own installer.

### Update and uninstall

Run the install command again to update everything, or update one application from its folder with its
`update.sh`. To remove one application, or all of them:

```sh
"$HOME/.local/opt/text-editor/uninstall.sh"
"$HOME/.local/opt/text-editor/uninstall.sh" --all
```

`--list` shows every install it knows about. Each application's install record is in `~/.local/share/vexelray-installer/installs`,
which is also how the applications find and start each other.

### Is it safe to pipe a script into sh?

Read it first - it is one file: [`install.sh`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/preflight/install.sh). It runs only installers whose SHA-256
matches their application's manifest, never asks for root, and writes nowhere outside your home folder.

A macOS installer is planned.
